scope: Historical SPN-115 routing checkpoint; current-main integration and subsequent edits need new same-head CI/reviews.

method.source: Public GitHub REST workflow run and complete per_page=100 jobs response; plan and result decoded from Actions job logs.
method.wallSecondsAfterFirstAllocation: last allocated job completed_at - first allocated job started_at
method.runnerSeconds: sum(completed_at - started_at) for jobs whose REST runner_id is non-null and >0; excludes skipped jobs and is not billed minutes
method.failureLatency: First useful injected Lib tests error at 2026-10-30T04:23:54.4007841Z: 81.4 seconds after run creation; job conclusion at +85 seconds. Positive full/targeted runs had zero failed jobs and no measured time-to-failure.
method.resultSummary: Coverage result and responsiveness summaries retain relevant exact fields; full decoded plan retained, hash checked. Raw logs/artifacts supplement, not implied to remain available permanently.

limitations: Observational full/targeted comparison, not controlled benchmark: SPN-052 and evidence bookkeeping changed between sources.
Hosted runner variation and full run initial queue (437 seconds) prevent attributing all wall-time difference to routing.
Successful jobs plus preserved failOnFlakyTests support zero first-attempt acceptance failures; no production flake-rate estimate from these two runs.
Historical callback/mobile evidence uses emulation, not physical devices.
Run/PR API pull_requests base/head fields may reflect later current PR metadata; immutable identity comes from retained plans.
Raw diagnostic artifacts remain supplementary and expire after 7 days; plan/results after 30 days.
